summary: The assembled installed package and exact legacy quarantine work in the bounded deterministic tests. Two integration errors remain: an offline test deletes prior evidence outside its caller-selected sandbox, and uninstall can partially remove files before discovering a preexisting non-directory parent without reporting the completed removals.

reviewer.independence: Separate critic with sole review writer ownership after the builder released. No product repairs, archive edits, or subagents. Review writes stay under sage.

requirements_and_spec_fit.reason: The 14-file installed product, documented CLI flows, receipt ownership, and selected 186-file quarantine are directly evidenced; E1 violates evidence preservation and temporary-test isolation, and E2 leaves the declared uninstall/reporting boundary incomplete.

architecture_and_coherence.reason: The installed package retains two explicit entrypoints, independent state paths, event authority, immutable knowledge generations, and a source-only lifecycle helper. The errors are bounded implementation and verification defects rather than a competing architecture.

correctness_and_evidence.reason: The exact-byte relocated full suite passes 77 tests with zero failures/errors/skips and the installed documentation passes 14 commands. Independent negative probes expose two observable defects beyond those passing tests; the critic does not convert green assertions into a complete integration claim.

simplicity_and_context_efficiency.reason: The 25-line main and 19-line promotion spines route to package-local branch references; only two deterministic helpers install. Lifecycle remains a small source-only copy/receipt operation. Neither finding requires a runtime framework or physical transaction protocol.

orchestration_and_model_routing.reason: The installed prose preserves adaptive zero-agent/delegated modes, live schema authority, user overrides, requested/effective uncertainty, one-writer ownership, and bounded uncalibrated routing priors. This scores only preservation and deterministic assembly; actual live routing efficiency remains unscored.

safety_reversibility_and_recovery.reason: Receipt path/type rejection, symlink controls, modified/unowned file retention, empty-directory/runtime preservation, and installed knowledge rollback have positive evidence. E1 destructively removes earlier test evidence, and E2 misses a predictable parent-type check before removals, so the gate cannot pass.

verification_strength.reason: The comprehensive offline suite is useful and passes when relocated unchanged, but its hard-coded destructive test escapes the selected evidence root and has no assertion protecting earlier evidence. Independent probes reproduce that omission and a missing lifecycle parent-type case. No live or automatic-discovery result is inferred.

reporting_and_maintainability.reason: Historical scores and current limitations are explicit, and unowned filenames are reported without private contents. E1 undermines preserved evaluation history and E2 emits only lifecycle_rejected after six completed removals. Both need narrow correction before the reporting gate passes.

findings.title: Offline overlap test deletes earlier evidence outside the requested sandbox
findings.cause: The test ignores SAGE_EVALUATION_SANDBOX, selects a fixed integration-wave-r1-overlap-positive/target directory, and recursively removes it before installation. A fresh --evidence-dir therefore does not isolate the full suite.
findings.observed: An exact-byte relocated source suite passed all 77 tests while deleting a critic-created earlier-evidence sentinel beneath the fixed prior target and outside the supplied fresh-critic-suite evidence directory. The sentinel hash is retained. The real previous evidence directory was never executed against or changed by this critic.
findings.fix_check: Allocate the overlap target beneath the caller's fresh sandbox while preserving the positive target-inside-source condition. Run with two distinct evidence directories and a sentinel at the former hard-coded path; all tests must pass and the sentinel plus earlier evidence hashes must remain unchanged. No recursive cleanup of prior evidence is acceptable.

findings.title: Uninstall discovers a replaced directory parent only after unreported removals
findings.cause: Receipt preflight checks parent symlinks but does not verify that existing parent components are directories. The uninstall loop classifies and deletes one file at a time, so a later NotADirectoryError occurs after earlier owned files have already been removed.
findings.observed: After a valid install, moving skills/sage/agents aside and placing a regular user file at that path causes uninstall to remove six skills/sage/references files, then exit 2. stdout is empty; stderr contains only lifecycle_rejected and the failing descendant path. The modified parent and old receipt survive, but no removed/retained result explains the partial installation. Replacing the earlier-sorted references parent instead rejects before removal, confirming the outcome depends on iteration order.
findings.fix_check: Preflight predictable existing parent/type conflicts before any removal, or conservatively retain and explicitly report replaced parent subtrees under a documented contract. A late-order non-directory parent must not produce unreported partial deletion. Test both early and late order, preserve unrelated files and the replacement, and accurately state any remaining unexpected-I/O limits. A crash-atomic multi-file transaction framework is not required.

verified_observations: 77/77 full offline tests pass with no failures/errors/skips in an exact-byte relocated source copy; relocation is recorded and was necessary to avoid modifying prior evidence through E1.
Default source-root installation into a fresh target beneath the real source sandbox succeeds with exactly 14 owned files plus the receipt; all installed Markdown links resolve.

Installed state init/append/snapshot/terminal validation/report/resume and knowledge validate/stage/activate/retrieve/correct/rollback pass 14 documented commands from a separate working directory using installed sibling helpers.

Modified owned and unowned package files, private content, runtime files, and preexisting empty directories survive appropriate update/uninstall paths; reporting includes unowned names without private contents.
Seven malformed receipt index variants reject with structured exit 2 and no mutation. Empty-receipt parent symlinks reject without following or deleting the escaped receipt.

Missing required reference, reintroduced source-manifest, and shipped-source overlap reject before target creation. An unchanged retired owned extension is removed on update and inherited receipt hashes are retained.

All 186 SHA256SUMS entries match exact baseline Git bytes. Additional archive README and SHA256SUMS are explanatory metadata. Lifecycle is both archived and rewritten active; the eight baseline paths outside the inventory are seven rewritten entrypoints plus removed tracked bytecode, still recoverable in Git.
Candidate source/input hashes remain unchanged throughout review. Prior critic rounds and failed evidence were not rewritten; sage-claude was not edited.
limitations: This review scores all eight status dimensions only for deterministic assembled integration. Final/live quality, automatic Codex discovery, actual behavioral independence, effective routing, token use, money, and savings remain unrun and unscored.

The suite ran in a byte-identical source copy under the critic sandbox to contain the known destructive hard-coded target. Source-copy path relocation is an explicit environment difference; the real active installer also received separate public probes.

A critic-only Python -I startup experiment failed because that mode excludes sibling imports; it is outside the documented launch contract and is not a product defect. The -E follow-up ignored the no-bytecode environment and produced a confined cache, correctly retained/reported on uninstall. Subsequent documented examples used normal Python with explicit -B.

Two critic archive assertions were overly broad: the archive has explanatory metadata outside its 186-entry inventory, and the archived lifecycle path also has a rewritten active replacement. The raw audit and corrected conclusion are both retained; all 186 baseline byte comparisons passed.

The bundled quick_validate dependency remains unavailable because PyYAML is absent; no dependency installation or bundled-validator pass is claimed. Dependency-free source syntax, installed links, and explicit-only metadata were inspected.

No physical transaction, hostile-writer defense, broad crash recovery, or corrupt retained-knowledge-history recovery is claimed. E2 concerns a deterministic preexisting type conflict and missing partial-effect reporting, not those excluded guarantees.
next_action: Repair only the two frozen integration errors for integration-a1 round 2, retain this failed round and evidence, then independently recheck before opening the final/live gate.
